diagnostics: v1.10 decayed point margin; v1.9.1 flat 1u moneyline ROI headline (reporting only); v1.9 roster codes; v1.8 report gate and QB projection
market_blend_verdict: Composite weight -0.093 (95% -0.531 to +0.307): no reliable evidence the composite adds anything beyond the spread. Chronological blend vs market: -0.0005 log loss per game (95% -0.0032 to +0.0021; positive means the blend beat the market).
limitations: box score definitions approximate some official totals
design chosen after historical results reviewed; development evaluation, not untouched test
v1.1-v1.10 changes applied after v1 results were seen
point margin input (v1.10) chosen after the 2023-25 held-out seasons were seen
game-bootstrap intervals omit selection and serial-dependence uncertainty
availability: final injury-report status (no intra-week timestamps); same-week roster status ignored; no game-day inactives or late-week news
roster membership: week 1 uses week-1 roster membership (reserve-listed players there count as out)
QB projection: most recent starter among available rostered QBs (week 1: most starts last season); a newly signed starter is projected only when no rostered QB has team history
unit availability measures fresh absences; returns and arrivals do not offset them
forward ledger waits for final injury reports (game statuses) for both teams
target: binary home W/L; ties excluded from fit/evaluation but their prior stats retained
fit_timing: whole prior weeks only; no within-week coefficient updates
validation: prior-season-only recipe selection; weekly coefficients trained only on earlier game rows
profile_decay: 2^(-team-game age / selected half-life) times offseason retention per season boundary

availability_audit.rule: most recent roster week before the game (week 1: week-1 roster); off-roster players count as out
availability_audit.qb_rule: available QB on the reference roster QB list who most recently started for the team; else most team dropbacks; else most dropbacks anywhere; else league backup prior. Efficiency from all-team history.
